title: RunesSMP Recreation
description: This plugin adds the godmace and the Rune system, including adding the runes to other weapons than the mace (swords and axes every type)
body:
# The description is in the title °^°

📜 Commands

Command Description
/gmace get Gives the GodMace (without runes).
/gmace rune [name of the rune] Gives the selected rune to the player.
/gmace withdraw [all/specific rune] Withdraws one specific rune or all runes applied to the weapon currently held in the player's hand.

🔄 Aliases

All commands are also available using the /godmace prefix instead of /gmace.

Example:

  • /godmace get
  • /godmace rune Aegis
  • /godmace withdraw all
